test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Existing or happening in the same time period
solution:
The correct answer is: **Comtemporary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Contemporary** means existing or happening in the same time period.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Contemporary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Meanings of incorrect options:
 
 
• 1) **Inbred** - produced by breeding from closely related individuals, resulting in a limited gene pool.
 
• 2) **Exemplary** - serving as a desirable model; representing the best of its kind.
 
• 3) **Cosmopolitan** - familiar with and at ease in many different countries and cultures.
